effective.basis: TCG release of Retro Pack 2 (RP02-EN016), the first printing whose text drops the battle-position clause

changes.historical_text: Tribute 1 monster on your side of the field. Select 1 Insect-Type monster from your Deck that is 1 Level higher than the Tributed monster and Special Summon it on your side of the field in face-up Attack Position or face-down Defense Position. Then shuffle your Deck.
changes.modern_text: Tribute 1 monster. Special Summon 1 Insect-Type monster from your Deck whose Level is 1 higher than the Tributed monster's.
changes.summary: Functional erratum: the pre-RP02 text summons the searched Insect "in face-up Attack Position or face-down Defense Position", and the goat script implements exactly that (`Duel.SpecialSummon(g,0,tp,tp,false,false,POS_FACEUP_ATTACK+POS_FACEDOWN_DEFENSE)`, with the same position mask passed to `IsCanBeSpecialSummoned` in `s.spfilter`). The RP02-EN016 text drops the clause and the modern script summons `POS_FACEUP` only, so the era card can Set a Deck monster face-down - upstream's own annotation on the variant reads "summons monsters like cyber jar" - while the modern card cannot.

gap.reason: Project Ignis ships no implementation matching this version: none of the upstream historical variants in the pinned databases carries this version's card text. Reproducing it needs a custom script and a reserved passcode.
gap.behavioural_impact: Period ruling package on top of the text change. Activation condition: the modern `s.cfilter` (the release-cost filter) also requires `Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.spfilter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,0,1,nil,lv+1,e,tp)`, while the goat cfilter drops it, so the Tribute can be paid with no Insect of the right Level in the Deck. Failed-search verification: the goat operation adds `else Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK)`. Only the verification half is dated by the shared search-verification chronology, so this change is left unresolved.

review.notes: Chain starts at lineage v2 (PSV-EN068 / Master Collection Volume 1, 2004-12-01), which the goat cdb text matches exactly; v1 (PSV-E068, 2002-10-20) is an earlier cosmetic rewording and is not recorded. Trailing v3 -> v4 (GRCR-EN052, 2022-01-27) adds "had on the field" and drops "-Type": cosmetic, since both scripts capture the Tributed monster's Level at cost time via `e:SetLabel(rg:GetFirst():GetLevel())` and never re-read it. Ordering rationale: the position erratum is anchored to a 2009 printing while the verification procedure is attested in force through 2011-02-02, so the functional change precedes the ruling change. IMPLEMENTATION GAP: the intermediate version - RP02 text (face-up only) still played under the era ruling package - has no upstream implementation, so any period snapshot after 2009-07-24 but before the ruling package lapsed has no correct script available.
